# ratelimit (throttle-kit)

> Rate limiting for Rust: GCRA (Generic Cell Rate Algorithm) with pluggable
> backends (in-memory default; sliding-window, Redis, and SQLite optional) and
> an optional Tower layer with `X-RateLimit-*` headers and trusted-proxy
> client-IP identity resolution (REQ-THROTTLE-100..104).

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): GCRA semantics, feature flags, quick start, Tower integration, performance.
- [REQUIREMENTS.md](REQUIREMENTS.md): numbered requirements REQ-THROTTLE-100..104 with test traceability.
- [THREAT-MODEL.md](THREAT-MODEL.md): threat model.
- [PERF-SLO.md](PERF-SLO.md): performance SLOs and benchmark methodology.
- [COMPARISON.md](COMPARISON.md): head-to-head comparison with governor.
- [COVERAGE-NOTES.md](COVERAGE-NOTES.md): coverage notes.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): security policy.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): release history.

The GCRA correctness proofs (Lean) live in `proofs/`.
